definition.def: You can use global to describe something that happens in all parts of the world or affects all parts of the world.
examples: ...one of the most successful organizations fighting child poverty on a global scale.

definition.def: A global view or vision of a situation is one in which all the different aspects of it are considered.
examples: They are confident their leader is taking a global view on important issues.
